title: Daily Workout · October 15
note: Thursday, October 15 · 60–65 minutes. No workout on October 14. Progress from five 90-second jogs to five 2-minute jogs if recovered. Reduce to 90 seconds if breathing is unusually difficult. Stop for groin or back pain, chest pain, dizziness, or unusual palpitations.
